name: Merging-unit time-quality interface
summary: Identifies the timing-quality status associated with the published measurement information.
description: Identifies the timing-quality status associated with the published measurement information. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Time synchronization health” at the input and “Measurement timing-quality indication” at the output. Time quality and data quality need separate interpretation.
